title: Carbonda CFR 696 49cm Carbon Gravel Bike & Carbon Gravel 650b Wheelset

takeaways.text: 2018-edition 49 cm frame (later years reportedly shortened reach slightly); at about 161 cm the owner found it a little long until a bike fit changed the bar reach and stem.
The 2× Ultegra hydraulic build on Carbonda 650B carbon wheels weighed about 17.5 lb (7.9 kg) without pedals or accessories; the wheelset was about 1,350 g without tape.
The owner rated Carbonda's wheels 8/10, with some uneven carbon finish but no truing issues after 18 months; frame chips came mostly from bus-rack commuting.
After about 2,000 miles, mostly road commuting with some gravel, it has worked well, though the owner found the handling a little twitchy at 49 cm.

Buying direct was smooth: the seller built the wheels to spec, offered paint options, and the frame arrived in under a month; his frame had a threaded BSA shell, while the owner believed only press-fit was offered later.

disclosure: The creator reviews their own frame bought from Carbonda; the description mentions no sponsorship or supplied product.
summary: Owner walk-round of a 2018-edition 49 cm CFR696 after about 2,000 miles of mostly road commuting: fit for a 161 cm rider, the about 7.9 kg build, handling, wheelset and the ordering experience.
